title: Generative AI for DevOps Engineers
overview: This course provides an in-depth exploration of how Generative AI can enhance DevOps workflows, including CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code (IaC), log analysis, anomaly detection, security monitoring, and incident response. Participants will learn how to integrate AI-driven automation into DevOps pipelines, leverage AI-powered chatbots for support, and optimize cloud operations using AI tools.

By the end of this training, DevOps engineers will be able to use Python-based AI frameworks, OpenAI APIs, and cloud-native AI services to build intelligent DevOps solutions that improve efficiency, security, and scalability.
audience: DevOps Engineers & SREs seeking to automate and optimize operations using AI.
Cloud Engineers integrating AI in cloud-native applications and workflows.
System Administrators using AI for log analysis, security monitoring, and incident response.
Software Developers & Automation Engineers looking to incorporate AI in CI/CD.
Tech Leads & IT Managers exploring AI-driven DevOps strategies.
methodology: The course follows a hands-on, practical approach that includes:
Instructor-led sessions & demos – AI integration with DevOps workflows.
Live coding & hands-on labs – Using Python, AI models, and cloud AI services.
Practical exercises & real-world case studies – Implementing AI in DevOps.
Group discussions & Q&A – Exploring best practices and troubleshooting.
Capstone project – Deploying an AI-powered DevOps automation tool.
competencies: By completing this course, participants will gain skills in:
Leveraging AI for log analysis & anomaly detection.
Building AI-powered ChatOps bots for incident management.
Using AI for predictive scaling & cloud cost optimization.
Integrating AI in security monitoring & compliance automation.
Deploying AI-driven DevOps solutions in cloud environments.
objectivesIntro: Upon completing the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand how Generative AI enhances DevOps workflows.
Implement AI-based automation in CI/CD pipelines.
Use AI for log analysis, anomaly detection, and predictive monitoring.
Build AI-powered ChatOps bots for DevOps support.
Optimize cloud infrastructure using AI-driven cost management.
Deploy AI-based security monitoring and compliance automation.

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Generative AI for DevOps

items.text: What is Generative AI, and why does it matter in DevOps?
AI-driven automation in CI/CD, security, monitoring, and cloud management.
Overview of AI tools for DevOps (OpenAI API, LangChain, Hugging Face, AWS AI services).
Hands-on: Exploring AI-powered DevOps use cases with Python.
Automating CI/CD pipelines with AI.
AI-powered code review & static analysis.
Using LLMs to generate & optimize infrastructure code (Terraform, Ansible).
Hands-on: Building an AI-powered CI/CD assistant.

outline.title: Module 3: AI-Driven Log Analysis & Anomaly Detection

items.text: Using AI for log parsing & error detection.
AI-based anomaly detection in system & application logs.
Automating root cause analysis (RCA) using LLMs.
Hands-on: Developing an AI-based log monitoring tool.

outline.title: Module 4: AI for Incident Management & ChatOps

items.text: AI-powered ChatOps bots for automated troubleshooting.
Integrating AI with Slack, Teams, and Discord for real-time DevOps support.
AI-driven incident response automation.
Hands-on: Building an AI chatbot for incident management.

outline.title: Module 5: Predictive Scaling & AI-Driven Cloud Cost Optimization

items.text: AI in predictive autoscaling for cloud workloads.
AI-powered resource allocation & cost optimization.
Using machine learning for anomaly detection in cloud billing.
Hands-on: Building an AI-driven cloud cost optimization tool.

outline.title: Module 6: AI for Security Monitoring & Compliance Automation

items.text: AI-based threat detection & security monitoring in DevOps.
AI for compliance automation (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST).
AI-powered vulnerability scanning & risk assessment.
Hands-on: Developing an AI security compliance checker.

outline.title: Module 7: AI-Driven Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Optimization

items.text: Generative AI for Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes automation.
AI-powered configuration drift detection & remediation.
Automating infrastructure provisioning & policy enforcement with AI.
Hands-on: Using AI to generate and optimize Terraform configurations.

outline.title: Module 8: AI in Performance Monitoring & Troubleshooting

items.text: AI-driven application performance monitoring (APM).
Predictive AI for capacity planning and fault prediction.
AI-enhanced troubleshooting for Kubernetes and microservices.
Hands-on: Developing an AI-driven performance monitoring system.
Using AI for Service Level Objective (SLO) tracking.
AI-based error budget analysis and reliability forecasting.
AI-powered post-mortem automation & RCA reporting.
Hands-on: Building an AI-powered SRE assistant.

outline.title: Module 10: Capstone Project – AI-Driven DevOps Automation

items.text: Final project: Developing and deploying an AI-powered DevOps automation tool.
Peer review and evaluation of AI DevOps implementations.
Certification and career guidance for AI-powered DevOps roles

extra.title: Prerequisites
items: Understanding of DevOps concepts & tools (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD).
Familiarity with Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) (recommended but optional).
